TOR_004.title: Bezalel & Oholiab ? Spirit-Filled Tabernacle Craftsmanship (Exodus 31)
TOR_004.context: Gold, silver, bronze, acacia wood, and fine linen arrive at Sinai for the Sanctuary of the Lord.
TOR_004.prompt: How do you commission the artisans and manage the freewill offerings of the congregation?

options.text: Appoint Spirit-filled master craftsmen (Bezalel & Oholiab) and halt collections once supplies overflow

outcomes.text: Exodus 36:6 fulfilled: generous stewardship overflows and the Tabernacle rises in exact divine pattern (+40 Score).
Every tribe contributes skilled artisans in unified worship (+25 Score).

options.text: Impose forced labor quotas instead of Spirit-led freewill offerings

outcomes.text: Camp morale drops when freewill worship is replaced by compulsion (-15 Score).

HIS_004.title: Esther's Royal Petition Before King Ahasuerus (Esther 4?5)
HIS_004.context: Haman's decree threatens the entire covenant people across 127 provinces from India to Ethiopia.
HIS_004.prompt: Mordecai reminds you: 'Who knows whether you have not come to the kingdom for such a time as this?' What is your move?

options.text: Call a three-day fast across Susa, then enter the inner throne room in royal courage

outcomes.text: Esther 5:2: the golden scepter is extended, Haman's plot is overturned, and the covenant line is preserved (+45 Score).
Courageous intercession turns mourning into nationwide deliverance (+30 Score).

options.text: Remain silent in the palace to protect personal comfort

outcomes.text: Deliverance rises from another place while royal stewardship is forfeited (-20 Score).

WIS_003.title: Job's Unshakable Integrity Under Severe Trial (Job 1?2 & 42)
WIS_003.context: Sudden calamities test your household, estate, and health while friends urge you to compromise.
WIS_003.prompt: How do you anchor your soul when prosperity is stripped away?

options.text: Worship the Lord in integrity, refuse to curse God, and pray for your friends

outcomes.text: Job 42:10: the Lord restores your fortunes twofold as you intercede for others (+45 Score).
Tested faith emerges purer than refined gold (+30 Score).

options.text: Abandon covenant trust and surrender to bitterness

options.text: Hold fast to covenant faithfulness?even if not delivered, we will not bow to idols

outcomes.text: Daniel 3:25: not a hair is singed, and the empire glorifies the Most High God (+50 Score).
Ten times wiser than all magicians and enchanters in the realm (+35 Score).

GOS_003.title: The Great Commission & Galilean Sending (Matthew 28:18?20)
GOS_003.context: The risen Lord gathers His disciples on the mountain in Galilee with all authority in heaven and on earth.
GOS_003.prompt: What strategic mandate defines your mission to the nations?

options.text: Go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing and teaching them to obey all Christ commanded

outcomes.text: Matthew 28:20: empowered by Christ's abiding presence to the end of the age (+50 Score).
Gospel witness multiplies across cities and households (+35 Score).

options.text: Keep the message insular and avoid cross-cultural outreach

outcomes.text: Kingdom expansion stalls inside regional borders (-15 Score).

EPI_003.context: Seven assemblies across Asia Minor face persecution, false teachers, and cultural pressure as the Alpha-Omega vision unfolds.
EPI_003.prompt: How do you equip the churches to endure and inherit the New Jerusalem?

options.text: Hold fast first love, conquer by the Blood of the Lamb and word of testimony, and keep the prophetic scroll

outcomes.text: Revelation 21:7: the one who conquers inherits all things in the Alpha-Omega Kingdom (+55 Score).
All seven lampstands burn bright in steadfast endurance (+40 Score).

options.text: Grow lukewarm like Laodicea, relying on material wealth alone

outcomes.text: Spiritual blindness requires urgent repentance and gold refined by fire (-20 Score).

scripture_trials.prompt: What dual purpose defines God's covenant blessing to Abraham in Genesis 12:2?3?
options: God blesses Abraham so that he will be a blessing, and in him all families of the earth shall be blessed
Blessing is restricted permanently to a single isolated valley
Abraham is commanded never to build altars in Canaan
Covenant promises depend entirely on Egyptian chariots
scripture_trials.explanation: Blessed to be a blessing?Genesis 12:2?3 establishes global covenant mission from the beginning.

scripture_trials.prompt: In 2 Chronicles 7:14, what four actions precede God hearing from heaven, forgiving sin, and healing the land?
options: Humble themselves, pray, seek God's face, and turn from their wicked ways
Double silver taxes, expand cavalry, build monuments, and close the gates
Wait passively without prayer or repentance
Seek alliances with surrounding empires
scripture_trials.explanation: 2 Chronicles 7:14 anchors national healing in humble prayer, seeking God, and genuine repentance.

scripture_trials.prompt: To what is the person compared who delights in the law of the Lord and meditates on it day and night?
options: A tree planted by streams of water that yields its fruit in season and whose leaf does not wither
Chaff that the wind drives away
A reed shaken in the wilderness
A cistern that holds no water
scripture_trials.explanation: Psalm 1:3 contrasts rooted, fruit-bearing stability with rootless chaff.

scripture_trials.prompt: What is promised to those who wait for (hope in) the Lord according to Isaiah 40:31?
options: They shall renew their strength, mount up with wings like eagles, run and not be weary, walk and not faint
They will be exempt from every journey
They will never need fellow believers
Strength comes from relying on horses and chariots
scripture_trials.explanation: Isaiah 40:31 promises supernatural endurance for leaders who trust the Lord.

scripture_trials.prompt: In John 15:5, what does Jesus teach about bearing lasting spiritual fruit?
options: Whoever abides in Christ and Christ in him bears much fruit, for apart from Him we can do nothing
Branches bear fruit independently once detached from the vine
Fruitfulness comes from outward appearance alone
Only temple scribes can bear fruit
scripture_trials.explanation: John 15:5 centers all enduring kingdom fruitfulness in vital union with Christ.

scripture_trials.prompt: How does Jesus declare His eternal sovereignty at the close of Scripture in Revelation 22:13?
options: I am the Alpha and the Omega, the first and the last, the beginning and the end
History is an endless random cycle with no author
Only the first era matters
The prophetic word is sealed forever without fulfillment
scripture_trials.explanation: Revelation 22:13 completes the Alpha-Omega arc uniting Genesis and Revelation.
